exposure: level of fetal head above the pelvic brim
cohort: 350 primigravidas at term with single live intrauterine gestation, vertex presentation, and no cephalo pelvic disproportion
finding: Primigravidas with an unengaged fetal head at term were more likely to have longer labors and require interventions such as oxytocin augmentation.
mod_finding: 43.4% of women with a free-floating head delivered by cesarean section, though this was not statistically significant (P = 0.087).
